APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Complete the ten-resource ansibleops provider as one coherent Terraform lifecycle/reconciliation system.

outputs.DIFFICULTY_EXPLANATION: The task couples ten differentiated Linux resource families through shared Terraform lifecycle semantics: stable external identity, native drift observation, transactional mutation/state publication, scoped ownership, runner failure behavior and canonical normalization. Correctness therefore depends on coherent cross-component invariants rather than isolated resource CRUD.
outputs.SOLUTION_EXPLANATION: The reference completion centralizes lifecycle identity/normalization and uses structured Ansible execution for Create/Update/Delete while Read observes Linux state natively. State advances only after successful mutation; failures remain retryable, owned deletions remain scoped, and equivalent representations converge without replay.
outputs.VERIFICATION_EXPLANATION: Structural verification maps the public contract to 30 F2P and 6 P2P cases, with same-chat Q1 NO_GAP, Q2 COVERED and Q3 CLEAR. Fresh empirical Oracle/NOP execution remains intentionally deferred to the registered DETERMINISTIC_VALIDATION gate and is not claimed here.
